I added in a GRATEFUL section which helps each evening.

author: MrAaronChristian

title: Really Helpful!
content: This journal is so good. It�s very therapeutic. The hints and prompts so thoughtful. This really helps me reflect and I�ve never been a reflective person.
author: Dee741

title: Wonderful App
content: Very helpful to plan my day to day activities and can be used as a diary. Amazing app which comes for free
author: Kashif6977

title: Awful design update
content: I've loved this app for years, but the latest visual design update is epically dreadful. Vibrant colours replaced with bland, depressing grey. I used to feel happy and energised when I opened the app, but now I feel sad and depressed every time I use it. I'm a premium subscriber, but I'm now looking for an alternative journaling app.
author: Mike1366

title: Poor performance
content: Used this app years ago with great success on my phone. Now I�ve got an iPad, and is amongst the recommended apps, thought I�d rekindle journaling again. However, the performance is DIABOLICAL! App hangs all the time making it impossible to do anything. Such a shame, used to be great.
author: Pilot2k5

title: Excellent journaling app
content: Really enjoy using this. Clean interface, easy to use, reliable.
author: Raekwon The Chef

title: Simple diary form
content: Really the title says it all - a quick and easy way of keeping track of busy lives.
author: ChristopherRobin1950

title: Excellent app for journalling and ideas
content: Best app ever for journalling. I�m using it on a daily basis for the past 10+ years!
author: Abstraiko

title: Give them an award again! I love it!
content:
Been using Day One for many years now. Compared to buying a Moleskine notebook, £22 a year is cheap. I don’t mind the subscription as long as they keep a great app going. More people need to support them because this is the best journaling app. 
I could just use Notes or Evernote, but I like to keep it separate from those. I write so much and find journaling my life has helped me grow and develop and remember more. This app is essential and I use it every day.
author: Tofu_Boy

title: Fantastic!
content:
Great app to put my thoughts and ideas down. Plenty of features to keep everything organised. Being able to create multiple Journals allows me to keep things separate and categorised. I’ll be taking advantage of the physical book at some point for sure!
I’d like to see a a few features added such as toggle-list/ spoiler-collapse list and also the ability to change text colour/font.
author: ivanc.digital

title: iOS 16 only?!
content:
Supporting only the very latest version of iOS seems like an act of self-harm on the part of the developers, unnecessarily limiting the audience for the app and needlessly alienating long-time customers who are still happily using it on various devices, not all of which were purchased in the last few weeks.

It’s a journaling app, for heaven’s sakes, not a high-spec video game that needs the latest and greatest GPUs and rendering software.  It should be able to run just fine on an iPhone 3, or an iPad 1.
author: Martin Janzen

title: I start my days with Day One
content:
Great app.  Love it.  I’ve created a number of templates and always start my day with my main one.

I’ve been using it for . . . Wow!  This is my 7th year.  And it’s great to grounding myself at the start.  I have a template that starts with reviewing the day before, moving into gratitude, meditation, etc.  and it ends with ‘what are my top 3 things to focus on today’.  Day One makes it easy to capture photos, thoughts and to tag key things too.

I wouldn’t be without it.  Highly recommended.
author: Marycollin Bham

title: So much love for this app.
content:
Day One is absolutely fantastic, mostly bug free despite many major updates - the team is second to non. 

I’d highly recommend this app for everyday journaling, meal tracking and even more so for keeping on top of your mental health, especially while in lockdown. It’s so rewarding, especially after a year when you start getting ‘on this day’ posts which allows you to physically see how much you’ve grown over past years.
author: Frankleweenie

title: Welcome to Today
content:
Version 5 and its addition of Today has been a magical transformation for me. I’d drifted away from Day One and given up on routinely recording what I’m doing. I’m now re-motivated and much enjoying becoming a routine logger. Too many other apps want to show you how beautiful they are. Day One helps me show myself how interesting and varied my life is, and that it’s worth tracking. 

I had a mix-up in my accounts but got a prompt and friendly support from the developers.
author: Ax 22

title: Superb
content: Far and away the best journal writing system I have used and I’ve tried a few. Delighted that end-to-end encryption has been implemented and I now have that all sorted out rather than the basic at rest encryption. I also used the help chat to sort out an issue I was having, they guy couldn’t have been more helpful or responsive which is unusual in this day and age. I recommend this application wholeheartedly.
author: QFieldBoden

title: A really good solid app that’s totally fit for purpose
content: I have used this for years. I don’t even mind the subscription. It’s modest. It’s justified as it syncs across all my devices seamlessly. And that costs money. So fair play. The support is responsive. The features are what you need and work well. And it just works across all my devices. Which is important as I love just popping notes into it whenever and wherever. Easy recommendation.
author: artfry

title: Day One has been a lifeline in lockdown
content: I have been journaling now for 8 years and find that it really helps me. I guess writing stuff in my journal helps me process and pray through everything going on and coming back years or months later to both see prayers answered and how I have managed to work through things is encouraging. I love that it’s so easy to add photos and format text to how you want. Thanks DayOne team!
author: Olimobile

title: So far so good!
content: I always start with the best intentions of keeping a journal but don’t seem to be able to carry it out. Recently being diagnosed with a form of transient amnesia I seem to forget about filling one in. Then start again after a period. With this very nice app, with the reminder and the ease to just text and record. I’m so far keeping a track of events that may give me a better understanding of who I am. Thank you to the people behind this application!
author: tenick157

title: Location no longer works in latest update
content:
I’ve used this app for years. It does most things I want in a journal app, but I’ve had to downgrade to 3 stars as it no longer gets weather for past entries as it used to, but even worse, it suddenly stopped showing an address as I create an entry, just the coordinates since the last update.

It’s *very* annoying having to add an action of selecting the address now, for every entry.

Please at least bring back a choice of having the actual address or coordinates.
author: alipix

title: Favourite app
content:
This is my favourite app! I love how easy it is to use and that I can add photos and search older entries easily. I don’t like posting on social media but want to have my memories stored somewhere and this app is perfect. I’m looking forward to using the book printing in the future.

Improvement:
The only thing I would like is to be able to decide which photos are bigger and which ones are smaller so that they fit on the page better.
author: Stanleii

title: Ripoff of the classic users let’s monetise again!
content: I don’t know what was behind ver 2.0 and why they decided to make 2.0 A’s it is the same app. But to be honest was a very weird move. Anyway app is more sluggish than the old classic some some ui decision seems to be a bit off. But the worst part is that they want to charge me one more time or begging for sub. And I know that I can update for 48 (it will be almost what 90 pounds? For classic and 2.0?) to the lifetime version but I’m afraid that after that they will decide that now they will do version 3. Not a chance boys. I hope that this biz model will not work for you and you will loose. All the best. Oh yeh and if you are looking for a less pricey app try journey.
author: Apple Sie dowie

title: Magical
content:
I’ve had this app for years. I find it so easy to use, and I get to document my life. I enjoy looking back through the years, all the wonderful and challenging times. We easily forget unless we keep these reminders. I get to enjoy it through my life… and it’s a legacy piece for my daughter. I wish I had a life story of my ancestors documented, worts and all. 

Should have been around sooner! Great app - thank you!
author: SianDhillon

title: Version 3 a backwards step
content:
I'm now into my 3rd Year of journalling with this App.  I make an entry every day and even the mundane becomes interesting when you use the 'On this day' feature to look back over time.  

I am not a fan of the new editor in version 3.  Everything just seems a little more difficult/less intuitive.  Specifically access to the date editor, mark-up and moving photos.  I really valued the ability to drag a photo to any point in your text.  Very handy if you write your journal in a single block and add the photos later. 

Also the auto-bolding of the first line is very hit and miss with no easy way to fix it.

Not your finest hour - sadly a lot of the most recent reviews seem to agree
author: Pennie Ingsdon

title: New UI - What Happened??!!
content:
I cannot believe the developers stood back, looked at this recent update and thought ‘yeh, good job’. What in the world were you thinking! It doesn’t tick any boxes in terms of improved function (the buttons are now in the wrong place) nor appearance (it’s flat and bland). Plus, it’s maybe my eyes, but why is it now using such a small font you need a magnifying glass! 

Please go back to the old layout until someone has thought this through. It really is bad! It looks like something from the 1980’s!
author: Gary AE

title: Excellent for Journalling
content: I use Day One every day, first adding a picture of the Daily Telegraph front page from the News App. Then every year it tells me what was front page news a year ago or more on the same date. During the day I make notes about anything happening of interest and again “On this day” shows it every year. It tells me when it happened, where it happened and how I felt about it if I put that in.
author: Hallsworthb

title: Amazing, best diary ever!
content:
Finally a diary that makes sense.  You can customise exactly how you want it, you can add sections and headings to help keep organised.  Simple to use and lots of features. Really tidy, not cluttered like some. I can see at a glance without being confused as you can use red text to highlight etc. 
Feels very secure.  Very good online support too. My constant search for the perfect diary is over, I am 100pc sticking with this one
author: Davinaisnotimpressed

title: New update is beyond awful
content:
Thanks for removing the option to use the app one handed. Now I need two hands to be able to reach the top to choose between media, calendar and list. Idiotic. You ruined the app. Removed the logically positioned and useful buttons at the bottom and put them out of reach. I have no words for this sort of "design" choice. It's just plain dumb and very user unfriendly. And the irony is you didn't gain anything, we just lost essential functionality. Your UX director should be fired for such catastrophy.

Edit: the design keeps going from bad to worse. Now you've added MORE bezel at the top? That says "all entries"? Genious!
author: alobebane

title: Versatile tool that ticks so many boxes
content: I very rarely write App Store reviews but I have loved Day One for many years now, through its various iterations and have always found it a very useful tool. I use it from everything from daily journaling through to meeting notes and planning things for my business. It’s well designed, looks great (often undervalued) and does exactly what it says on the tin!
author: Freelance Films

title: Much better than journal app I was using before
content: I love that Day One allows for multi-device sync and that I can share my journal with family members. My reason for 4 stars and not 5 is that functionality seems to be inconsistent between devices. There are some actions that can only be done on iOS, others that can only be done on the web app. Also there seems to be a bug when deleting a journal, it keeps reappearing.
author: doublew98

title: Wow.
content:
I have been using DayOne since the early days and it just keeps getting better and better. So versatile. Such a pleasure to use, both for personal and work. (And it has a beautiful interface)

What amazes me, though, is that the team has an excellent response turnaround. I had a question and some issues with the recent Mac version and Adam responded almost immediately to my emails. Now THAT is first rate. Nothing can tempt me away from this app!
author: Ansk

title: Too many upgrades!
content: I’m a keen, long-term user of Day One, but I am tired of all the upgrades that add features I don’t use and mess up the ones that I do use, either by changing the design or by introducing new bugs. The latest is synching between devices; I wrote a long entry on my desktop but found it didn’t appear on my iPad. So I pressed sync on the ipad, and it updated the desktop instead, losing all my work! Never had that happen before.
author: Fredric W

title: Why the large blue area?
content:
On the whole I like Day One, but did not appreciate being forced to buy premium version, as it seemed there would be no backup otherwise.

Also why the large blue area above the timeline? I’d rather see more of my timeline. I would also like to see a journal entry in full without automatically going into edit mode. This is not an improvement in my view.
author: ljs.co

title: Unable to install
content: I am a customer who purchased the app few years ago. And I paid for it. Now the app tried to refresh or something and got stuck in for days on my iPhone. So I have deleted the app with intention to reinstall it. But I’m unable to install it. In the App Store the button just doesn’t do anything. I wrote to the support and I was told that they only support premium customers. Is this a joke? I can access the product I paid for and the say they can help me and I should write a review so maybe someone gets back to me. So here I am. Writing how dissatisfying my experience was with the app and the support.
author: Kaza1909

title: Still the Best
content:
I’ve tried many journaling apps, this is by far the best for me. The interface is gorgeous, intuitive and makes adding the essentials very quick and easy. Most meta details are added automatically like location, time, date etc and the new text editor makes things much quicker and natural to edit.

Worth every penny to a development team this strong...
author: r2thebizel

title: More than a Journal
content: I’m using Day One for more and more things. As a Journal it is superb, but I’m increasingly using it for note taking. Entries can be found easily through search and the ability to create audio entries is also very useful to me. I also like the editor, although I see some people complaint about it. For me it is perfect with all the options I need. Sync has been flawless. There is nothing to complain about here.
author: bcnbutty

title: Good
content: I've always wanted to start journaling and this is one of the best apps I've found. It was recommended to me on social media and it's really great. You can track your journaling and diary and sometimes journaling is the best way to get out your thoughts and stuff. I would really recommend this app, which is the reason why I gave it first. Just download this app; you won't be disappointed.
author: FunnyKoala6

title: New features suggestion
content:
I absolutely love this journaling app! I don’t see myself using anything else, I’m happy with both the free and premium versions.

I have a new feature suggestion that just brightens up the experience a bit more: can we please add more highlighting colour options!? 😍 My favourite are pastel colours, but maybe have a variety of different colours for different tastes? 
💚🩷🧡💜🩵
author: LassieDAx

title: Amazing…
content: Never thought I would see myself keeping a journal but here we are, had some struggles of late and someone suggested writing things down and after a few days of using my notes and it being all over the place I got this, only using the free version and what’s went from a morning and night entry has become multiple entries per day.
author: Tam1888

title: Good
content: Just started using this journal and so far I really like the layout. Easy to use and the ui is pleasant as well. Lots of options and tweaks. I particularly like that you don’t have to buy the premium version to be able to use this app which to be honest I wouldn’t benefit from. Using it as is is good enough for myself with the options given. Overall a really nice looking app.
author: Dragula1303

title: An Excellent Journal/Diary
content:
I’ve been using the App for around 11 years. I use it on a daily basis as a personal journal/diary. I love it! 

I was delighted a few years ago when version 2 was launched
because I was finally able to insert images into the body of the text which wasn't possible on version 1. I have no plans to upgrade and insert videos. 

TODAY: I often copy parts of my journal to my WordPress blogs, though I would not want to link it and make it public. 

I disliked the prompt that used to popup on each new journal page. My journal is a diary NOT a blog, therefore the prompt was irrelevant. 

It’s always interesting to look back at my previous journal entries and I like being prompted/reminded to look back.
author: The real MrsW

title: Great App
content:
This app is great for a general journaling aspect, the free features are brilliant when other apps in the genre don’t give you as much. The prompts are not basic like other apps and they make you think about your answer instead of a tick box exercise. 

On thing i would like is that you can link phone and IPad without paying the fee. Other than that i love it!
author: aimeet987

title: Waste of your time
content:
The app has a glitch for iPhone users where if the app offloads (undownloads itself after a period of not using), all of your journal entries and data are deleted. I contacted them about this and they weren’t bothered in the slightest, said they’d reported the glitch to Apple and that was it. If your users are all reporting and experiencing the same problem, do something about it. The only way to save your data is to pay to have it saved (of course, because why would a free app actually be completely free).
I lost years of journal entries, total waste of time. Download an app that saves your entries.
author: maxi1992

title: Deserves a review
content:
Day One deserves a review...I don’t write reviews that often, as after many years of journaling I feel that I’ve finally found a tool that suits my writing method.

I like the idea of having one tool for all tasks including writing. However, using this proper journaling app I’ve realised this offers better flexibility and an increased level of detail which make it much more fun - and hopefully more interesting to read at a later date.

It takes a bit of getting used to (hence 4 stars and not 5)and I’ve had to spend time learning the functionality, it’s worth it though because now I have an useful tool I use daily.

If you like journaling, want a tool you can pick up and write in at any time add pictures, tags and vids, then try Day One.
author: Mark DL

title: Loving it!
content:
I love the app, it makes journaling easier and more fun. 

I also love the various ‘folders’ you can create with different colours, which is great if you want to keep some journaling separate from the main space (for example I am doing a challenge, which I like to keep separate from everything else so it easier to see progress on the challenge).
author: AintaPlanetB

title: Love this app
content: I don’t use Facebook and I don’t do a lot of social media but I do like to keep a diary with photos and this is the perfect app for that. I use it on my phone, iPad and sometimes update with my PC. I’ve been using this now for 6 months and love looking back at the diary. Just wish I could print the books (only available in the US) but apparently coming to the UK soon?
author: MalarkyClarkyUK

title: Good app but the “premium subscription” is a JOKE
content: Okay so hear me out on this. This is a good app, it’s a diary right? How much does a diary cost? Not that much. Why should I have to pay a whole £30 per year for something that I should pay for once and once only. I think maybe instead of doing a ridiculously expensive yearly subscription you should make it a one time payment. Nobody is going to pay that much unless they’re rich. And the reality is is that a lot of people who really need a diary, cannot afford them, and certainly cannot afford £30 a year! Please change this
author: sarah_el_1

title: Great App 5 Plus Stars
content: It's simple, if life is worth living then life is worth recording. Day One, is easy to use and the paid version is worth every penny. My very good friend David Bruce recommended it to me. I am now recommending it to you and the rest of the world.    I now have a Piano Journal to keep up with areas I am learning about both Music Theory and the practical skill of playing.
author: Dave H - Wolvey

title: Fantastic App
content: I have been using day one whilst on a placement with university, it has been brilliant. It allows me to upload various media into each entry which is really useful, it is also a very easy interface to use. As I student teacher being able to keep track and have a space to evaluate my day is very good and an app I will use through my studies. Would recommend this app to anyone!
author: Con.C.A

title: Newbie to journaling
content: With help from a daily reminder and Home Screen shortcut widget life has been made easy to record what the goings on are in my day. It can also be versatile due to being able to have numerous journals along with various formats of journaling too (text/picture/voice). Would recommend to anyone looking to record well…anything!
author: GaryH14__

title: I Can use this app anywhere
content:
I’ve wanted to get into writing a little at least once a day and this app is perfect for that as I can use it on phone, tablet, computer and even smart watch so I can take my time with a keyboard for a long post or send a brief note over with transcription via the watch. 

I save at least one picture a day too.
author: Elliott_APLTR

title: My favourite app in the world!
content: My favourite app in the world, no questions! I love how it’s designed to store all your info, in whatever format, I tell everybody about it. Journaling has changed my life and I doubt i would have been able to stick to the habit, if you not for Day One. The fact that I pay the subscription says a lot lol. Great app, great features, prompts and all. I love you Day O
author: Aishurr

title: Life story
content:
I live in the uk and this is a brilliant app, I have documented my life for four years now and I have a yearly book made. 

It is a very modern way of telling your story the journeys you have been on in life !

Pro isn’t something I use because I spend the money on books. If there was some kind of incentive to the pro ie money off books then I would upgrade.
author: Double A 10/04

title: Brilliant but...
content:
Having bought this app a couple of times over the years, I was dismayed and upset with the company decided to change to subscription payments. 

What I didn’t know is that if you had already purchased the app their is a Plus tier which you automatically are on. It means that all the previous functions still work. This is great and I’m really happy the company decided to work this way. 

Ulysses which has decided on a similar subscription model has locked me out of an app I paid even more money for and this is completely unfair. 

So well done to Dayone and that has actually made me think about subscribing when enough new features are added. Intelligent customer service.
author: marliefrugal

title: Useless to me…
content: I was looking for an app where I could keep a journal in all security and privacy. On This Day ticked all the boxes. I downloaded it, created an account as instructed but when I tried to sign in with my Apple ID, it couldn’t. Okay. I then opened an account with my gmail (2nd option). Guess what? it didn’t recognise me either when I tried to log in. I tried so many times. I wasted more than hour. Also, it is overly complicated. I am so disappointed. I really liked the idea of this app. It felt safe and I was ready to get the premium. Alas, it is useless to me if I can’t sign so, I deleted it.
author: Francine1423

title: Great but need widget adjustment
content: I love using this app as a “to-done” list. Every day I keep a journal of the things that I’ve achieved and it really keeps me positive and motivated. I love that the UX/UI shows the first three lines on each journal day entry, that way I can see the top three things I’ve achieved that day. It’s great. I would rate this app five-star but the new widgets don’t have an option where I can see my text entries that day in the widget. It’s only pictures. If you guys can update the widget functionality so that my eg top 3 text journal entries can be seen in the widget, I’ll go straight to 5 star ! Actually that’s the only reason I’m writing this. It’s a widget SOS 🆘
author: gamegeeked

title: Good with a major flaw!
content:
Day One mostly works very well for me. I really enjoy and appreciate this online journal which I use on my iPhone, my iPad and also on my Mac. I greatly appreciate the fact that it syncs flawlessly across the three platforms.

HOWEVER the major flaw is that the search facility from my point of view is very poor indeed!!

The search facility is good in getting you to the day you are looking for. However beyond that you are on your own! I tend to often write a LOT on one page! My problem is discovering the word I am looking for within the screeds I have written within that page.

I have asked Day One to improve this facility on more than one occasion through the years! and so far they have refused!
author: Robert John Tom Paul

title: App doesn’t open or complete updating
content: The app icon is stuck at updating and says “Loading” instead of “Day One”. It doesn’t open when I click it, and I can’t uninstall it when long clicking the icon. The blue button here in the App Store says “Open” but nothing opens when clicked. It’s a good and beautiful app when it worked.
author: Cédric Loke

title: The best journaling app
content:
During these times of self isolation, creating a journal has never been so useful and so mentalIy beneficial. This is the only journaling app that allowed me to add videos and photos the way I wanted. I have tried so many different journaling app and this is by a mile the best of all.
I’m very happy with the subscription for the premium version and it is totally worth it.
author: Fbs

title: Changed my life
content: I think my Day One streak is at around 160 days and that speaks for itself. I can’t explain how much this app has helped me and my mental health. I’ve never had the ability to collect my thoughts in such a natural and convenient way before. The ability to add a picture for each day is really special to me because I love capturing moments!
author: Tswegger

title: Syncing issues spoil app
content: This was definitely a five app.  I could make entries on multiple devices and they would sync perfectly. Then one day, I received a notification asking me to change my password for security reasons. Fair enough. Sadly, since then the devices have struggled to sync – in fact, they don’t do so any more at all.I’m now in the process of cancelling my subscription and seeing if I can find a similar app which synchronises more effectively.
author: Tsunt

title: Much improved
content: Having been an early adoptor of Day One the changes in Day One 2 are well received It is more user friendly, easier to look back on 'this day' events and more aesthetically pleasing My concern was the storage of my data from Dropbox to Day One's servers, but now that I understand the encryption process, I am satisfied that it is secure as can be
author: Avon1330

title: An easy to use free app.
content:
This is a no frills app. It is a very easy to use journal tool. I say no frills, but even the free version allows you to post photos. 
It is very similar to using a notebook. You have a blank page to write on, which is often the best way to capture my own thoughts. The top of the page formats to a bold title, the next line offers normal text. Straight forward and easy to use on an iPad.
author: An expat abroad

title: Really like updated version!
content: So much better but with one exception and that is I would like to be able to add more than one pic at a time in my daily record. Perhaps this is possible in the paid upgrade but I don’t want to pay for that so will just add pics as before in extra day’s entries. Shame tho! Otherwise perfect for me.
author: She1950

title: Don’t bother...
content:
Day One used to be an amazing app. Worked well and after you paid the quite hefty price to purchase the app it was nice knowing that you’d have all the updates released in the future.

Wait... that isn’t the case. A new subscription model is being force fed to us and we just have to accept that to gain new features we have to subscribe to a subscription.

I fully understand that the business would benefit from recurring payments. The problem is, why do that at the expense of your customers? It is quite clear that a large number of users don’t like this new subscription, so why force it? Has user experience been completely forgotten? The app was recommended to me by a friend, he actually told a bunch of us to get the amazing Day One app and so I purchased it. Right now he’s looking for a replacement too and he was a Day One fanboy from the way he tried getting people on the app. 

Why  can’t the developers use a donate button? Or better yet implement something that isn’t going to add new functionality and is completely optional, like a theme that you can pay for?

The developers are trying to mimic Microsoft as they’re doing well with their Office 365, but the difference is Microsoft’s giving you a saving in the short-term. You get far more benefits from using the subscription than you would buying each service separate. The same just doesn’t work for a diary app.

Seriously, just think about it for a few seconds... you want your customers to pay a subscription to post some text and maybe a few images? You can literally create a free WordPress blog - make it private and go to town with it.

Please start thinking about your customers. As the ratings go lower, less people will purchase the app, which means less people will get the subscription, which means you’ll be at a huge loss. The customers always make the business. Without us you wouldn’t have one. Think about the customers. Food for thought - why not create a poll on your website to pitch different methods of making additional income from the app. Ask the customers what they want and you’ll have less people complaining and more people purchasing.
